_doc: MAX2 U1(1) material zoning per fighter (art/tools/zone_grade.py; pipeline.build re-applies it after every build). Each zone: parts of the bake's part map, or boxes (rest position, Blender axes, m) x an ORM roughness band [lo, hi] x an optional max L*; hex = the hue (CIELAB angle of the colour), L = the zone's mean L*, C = its chroma, k = the texel's own L* deviation kept (default 1). Signature hues are content/fighters/<id>.json vfx.signature. Gate: lineup_qa sigPct >= 6 % and the bottom value band at L* 20-35.

the robe a deeper terracotta, apart from the cream hood and pauldrons
lower body into the dark band
signature oxblood red on the coat (mid body); the head, mask and cowl untouched (cards lane)

signature plum on the robe skirt (mid and lower body)
signature crimson on the slate torso cloth (no part map: torso box x cloth roughness x the darker cloth only, not the pale cowl, sleeves or apron)
